findings.evidence: Semantic grounding falsifies the MUSIC signal: no music-file access exists anywhere in the traced evidence. app/src/main/res/values-en/strings.xml:127 (<string name="sw_datenschutz_netz_text">) matches the pattern only through the word 'trackers' in the privacy copy 'Nibra does not request network access, has no account, no payment and no trackers.'; app/src/main/res/values-it/strings.xml:127 is the Italian translation of that same string ('...non ha account, pagamenti o tracker.'). simple-keyboard/src/main/java/rkr/simplekeyboard/inputmethod/keyboard/MainKeyboardView.java:413, 442, 534, 537, 541 match only on the framework class 'PointerTracker' (tracker.getLastCoordinates, tracker.processMotionEvent, PointerTracker.getPointerTracker) which handles on-screen touch geometry for key presses, not audio or music files. Forward trace to an off-device sink is impossible: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:5 carries the explicit comment 'Kein INTERNET-Recht' and the only declared permission is android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO (line 9); simple-keyboard/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml declares no permissions at all. Dependency review of app/build.gradle.kts (lines 114-143: androidx core/lifecycle/compose/navigation, Hilt, Room, DataStore, coroutines) and simple-keyboard/build.gradle.kts (lines 26-27: androidx preference, appcompat) shows no HTTP client (OkHttp/Retrofit/Ktor/HttpURLConnection), no Firebase, no Crashlytics, no analytics/ads SDK in any production source set.
findings.recommendation: No action required for MUSIC. Treat this pattern hit as a false positive ('tracker'/'PointerTracker') and declare no music-file collection in the Play Console Data Safety form. To keep this state verifiable, retain the 'no INTERNET permission' comment in app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml and keep the existing BauartTest.kt guard that asserts no network libraries enter the production dependency graph.

findings.evidence: Semantic grounding falsifies the RACE_ETHNICITY signal: no race or ethnicity attribute is modelled, stored, or transmitted anywhere in the traced evidence. app/src/main/res/values-en/strings.xml:108 (<string name="sw_einrichtung_willkommen_text">) matches only through the substring in 'no traces'; app/src/main/res/values-fr/strings.xml:108 and :127 match the French onboarding/privacy copy 'sans traces' and 'ni traceurs' — both are privacy assurances, not demographic fields. simple-keyboard/src/main/java/rkr/simplekeyboard/inputmethod/latin/LatinIME.java:489 matches only inside the debug guard 'if (TRACE) Debug.startMethodTracing("/data/trace/latinime")', and the flag is a compile-time constant disabled at line 83 ('private static final boolean TRACE = false;'), so even that on-device profiling file is never written in a release build. Forward trace to an off-device sink is impossible for the same structural reasons as above: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml declares only android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO (line 9) with an explicit 'Kein INTERNET-Recht' comment at line 5, simple-keyboard/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml declares no permissions, and neither app/build.gradle.kts nor simple-keyboard/build.gradle.kts pulls in any HTTP, telemetry, crash-reporting, or advertising SDK.
findings.recommendation: No action required for RACE_ETHNICITY. Treat this pattern hit as a false positive ('traces'/'traceurs'/'startMethodTracing') and declare no race or ethnicity collection in the Play Console Data Safety form. Optionally strip the dead Debug.startMethodTracing branch in LatinIME.java so future audits do not re-flag it, and keep the marketing claims in strings.xml (no network, no trackers) consistent with the manifest so the store listing stays defensible.
